full_judgment: 8. Keeping the provisions of these sections in view, if we revert to section 50 and section 102, it is to be observed that section 102 contains a provision which bars the jurisdiction of Civil Court with regard to the matters mentioned therein. And before considering its effects we are to resort to section 50, which finds place in Chapter IV, and this Chapter relates to enrolment of Waqf and it consists of five sections. Section 47 says that all Waqfs existing at or created after the Ordinance shall be enrolled at the Office of the Administrator and it can be enrolled on an application by the Mutawalli or by any person interested in a Waqf. The section provides particulars that should be supplied by the applicant. This section consists of 9 sub-sections and all of them need not be discussed except a brief reference to sub-sections (5) and (6). Sub-section (5) enjoins on the Administrator, on receiving an application for enrolment of a Waqf property, to send a copy of the application to the Deputy Commissioner of the District where the Property is situated to as-certain whether the property sought to be enrolled as Waqf is Khas property of the Government. Sub-section (6) says that if the application has not been rejected under sub-section (5) the Administrator may enroll the Waqf, if he thinks fit in respect of the genuineness and validity of the application and the correctness of the particulars as required under the Ordinance. The Administrator is required to give notice to the person administering the Waqf if the applicant is a person who is not administering it. The sub-section says that waqf created before the Ordinance shall be enrolled within three months from lie date of the commencement of the Ordinance and Waqf created after that date, with in three months of the creation of the Waqf. Section 48 prescribes the duty of the. Administrator to maintain a register of Waqf which shall contain the particulars contained therein. Section 49 empowers the Administrator to cause enrolment of Waqf of his own motion or direct the Mutawalli for enrolment and his power to amend the register of waqf. Section 50 authorizes the Administrator to decide if a property is waqf. Section 51 prescribes for notification of changes in enrolled wakfs.
